Odin | Senior Cloud Infra Engineer | Remote | Full time

We’re hiring a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to help establish Odin’s platform team. You’ll build and run the cloud foundation powering workforce visibility, security, and operations across critical-infrastructure construction projects.

We're in GCP, running on GKE and Postgres.

Apply here: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/odinlabs/jobs/4451905009
